opinions.note: The UNFCCC reports that COP31 concluded on November 22, 2026, without adopting the presidency-led cover decision.
The UNFCCC confirms that COP31 closed on November 22, 2026, without adopting the presidency-led cover decision.
UNFCCC and Carbon Brief confirm that COP31 concluded on 22 November 2026 without reaching consensus on or adopting the Presidency-led overarching cover decision (the 'Antalya Pact').

According to the Ukrainian Air Force's morning summary published on 22 November 2026 (and repeated by Ukrinform and The Kyiv Independent), Russia launched 186 strike UAVs (including 72 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, and Parodiya decoys) at Ukraine from 18:00 on 21 November.

Carbon Brief and the UNFCCC report that COP31 concluded on Sunday, 22 November 2026 without adopting the proposed cover decision (the 'Antalya pact') due to a lack of consensus over fossil fuels and climate finance.
The Ukrainian Air Force’s first morning summary reported that Russia launched 186 drones overnight, counting from 18:00 Kyiv time on November 21, 2026.
Focus Taiwan’s winners report confirms that Arrested Memory won two competitive awards, Best Art Direction and Best Sound Effects, at the November 22, 2026 ceremony in Taipei.

Neither Ukraine's Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War nor President Zelensky nor the Russian Defence Ministry reported any prisoner exchange taking place on 21 or 22 November 2026, with officials instead stating that preparations for a future large-scale exchange were still ongoing.

UKMTO Warnings 215-26 and 216-26 (and JMIC Advisory Update 116) report two attacks on outbound tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on 21 November 2026 at 05:00 UTC (09:00 GST) and 05:50 UTC (09:50 GST), in which the vessels were struck by unknown projectiles.
UKMTO Warning 216-26 reports that an unknown projectile struck a tanker’s engine room in the Strait of Hormuz at 09:50 Gulf Standard Time on November 21, 2026, within the event window.
At the November 22 ceremony in Taipei, Arrested Memory won two competitive awards, while Double Happiness and Kung Fu each won three.
The sources checked discuss a planned exchange, but none confirms a two-way POW exchange during the November 21–22, 2026 Kyiv-time window or establishes that none occurred.
Scioperi Italia reports that the MIT data checked at 14:00 local time on November 22, 2026, still listed the RSA FAST-CONFSAL-AV strike at Milan Malpensa for 13:00–17:00 with no revocation.

According to the Central News Agency (Focus Taiwan) report on the 63rd Golden Horse Awards held on Sunday, 22 November 2026, 'Arrested Memory' won two competitive awards (Best Art Direction and Best Sound Effects).

According to the Focus Taiwan (CNA) winners report for the 63rd Golden Horse Awards held on November 22, 2026, 'Double Happiness' and 'Kung Fu' tied for the most competitive awards with three wins each, while 'Arrested Memory' won only two awards (Best Art Direction and Best Sound Effects).

ENAV's official press release and contemporary strike reports from the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport confirm that the strike by ENAV staff at Milan Malpensa called by FAST-CONFSAL-AV remained in force and took place on Sunday 22 November 2026 from 13:00 to 17:00 (after being shortened from 24 to 4 hours).
